exactly_one_unusual_experiment.name: CLI_VERSION_SHADOW_SPOOF
exactly_one_unusual_experiment.intervention: Prepend a temporary fake sqlite3 executable reporting 3.53.4 to PATH while leaving the in-process Python SQLite mapping unchanged.
exactly_one_unusual_experiment.rollback: Remove the temporary PATH shadow; sqlite3 CLI becomes absent again and the Python runtime remains 3.46.1.
exactly_one_unusual_experiment.interpretation: A CLI version string is not a trustworthy attestation of the productive process mapping.

architecture_delta.new_invariant: Do not use an independently rebuilt SQLite binary as the identity substitute for a previously approved deployed binary unless reproducible-build equivalence is itself proven. Prefer promoting one immutable approved artifact (or package object) and bind the productive Frank generation to those exact deployed bytes plus source/version provenance.
architecture_delta.counterhypothesis: The two 3.53.4 binaries may be semantically equivalent and differ only because the build is not byte-reproducible; a raw hash gate can therefore create safe false negatives.
architecture_delta.next_falsifier: On the accepted Hostinger product service, deploy an owner/admission-pinned immutable fixed SQLite artifact, exercise the exact Frank DB/WAL write-checkpoint path through controlled restart, bind execution generation + DB path + runtime mapping + source/build/hash, and require downgrade/library-swap/rollback controls to fail closed.
